inline_comments.comment: The divider line previously received `nodeStyles` as an inline `style` attribute (`dividerLine.attr('style', nodeStyles)`), so user-defined `style` and `class` statements in the diagram would propagate to the divider. Now it only receives `class='divider'`, which means custom styling from the diagram source is silently dropped for the divider in both classic and neo looks. If preserving user styles on the divider is acceptable to drop, this should be called out explicitly in the PR description as an intentional change.

There is an extra space in the CSS descendant selector: `.node  rect` (two spaces between `.node` and `rect`). While functionally equivalent in CSS, it is inconsistent with the `.node path` rule on line 16 which uses a single space. Please normalise to a single space.

The `.edgeLabel` rule is indented with 4 spaces (`    .edgeLabel {`) while every other CSS rule in the file uses 2-space indentation. This inconsistency was introduced by this PR (the original used 2 spaces). Please align to the 2-space convention used by the surrounding rules.
